items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Prió Socarras, the two small brothers... we went together; were taking bachillerato

ctx.x: Okay. Before that Macho, What do you remember about school? What -- What did you do in school?

Well, I was in private school so I think I was the only Afro-Cuban, really dark fellow - oh another fellow that it was dark too - that his father was white and he owned a sugar mill in Santa Clara; so we was the only ones dark-complexioned in that particular school. Ah - Prió Socarras, the two small brothers, because the president was older, but we went together; were taking bachillerato, what they call a B. A.
There wasn't - we was in private school, but got to take the examination at the Instituto Havana.
